query:
SELECT 
  id, 
  gallon_number, 
  liters_purchased as raw_liters,
  CAST(liters_purchased AS DECIMAL(10,2))/100 as liters,
  amount_paid as raw_amount,
  CAST(amount_paid AS DECIMAL(10,2))/100 as amount,
  DATE_FORMAT(created_at, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i') as created
FROM fuel_purchases 
WHERE gallon_number = 1
ORDER BY created_at
